meta.name: Synthetic Classifier Seed Set
meta.note: Invented, labelled example utterances for the routing classifier. Fields: text, state_id (matches knowledge_base.json), intensity (1 low to 5 high), safety. Safety values: none, watch, escalate. An 'escalate' example must never be routed into a normal exercise; the correct behaviour is to surface human and crisis support and hand off. These labels are a seed set, not an exhaustive training corpus.

safety_levels.watch: Elevated distress. Respond with care and consider surfacing support options, but not an emergency.
safety_levels.escalate: Signals the person may be at risk or unable to cope. Do not run an exercise. Surface crisis and human support and hand off.
